2609.17091.title: Scaling-Score Conformal Prediction for Multi-Target Regression
2609.17091.paper_summary: Multi-target regression requires a model to simultaneously predict several related outputs. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free, finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees, but extending these to joint multi-dimensional regions in a model-agnostic, sample-efficient manner remains challenging: max-aggregation ignores scale differences, copula-based methods are only asymptotically valid, rectangular methods typically split the calibration set, and quantile or density-based methods require training a specialised model beyond a plain point predictor. We propose the scaling-score conformal method, which is model-agnostic (requires only component-wise absolute residuals), uses a single calibration set, and yields four nested output types: an outer rectangle (SCO) with valid joint coverage, the exact set R $α$ , a staircase (SC 2 ) over approximation of R $α$ , and an inner rectangle (SCI). A single hyperparameter $γ$ $\in$ (0, 1) controls the base-rectangle quantile level independently of $α$. We prove downward-closedness and a rectangular sandwich bound and derive a closed-form outer rectangle. Experiments on 29 realworld datasets confirm valid joint coverage; SC 2 with $γ$ = 1-$α$ consistently achieves competitive volume relative to baselines, with the advantage growing with output dimension d.
2609.17091.paper_summary_zh: 多目標回歸需要一個模型同時預測幾個相關的輸出。<lb/>符合預測提供無分佈、有限樣本的邊際覆蓋保證，但以模型無關、樣本高效的方式將這些擴展到聯合多維區域仍然具有挑戰性：最大聚合忽略了尺度差異，基於 copula 的方法僅在漸近上有效，矩形方法通常會拆分校準集，而基於分位數或密度的方法則需要訓練一個專門的模型，超出普通的點預測器。<lb/>我們提出了縮放分數符合方法，它是模型無關的（僅需要分量的絕對殘差），使用單一的校準集，並產生四種類型的嵌套輸出：一個有效的聯合覆蓋的外部矩形（SCO），確切的集合 R $α$ ，對 R $α$ 的階梯（SC 2 ）過度近似，以及一個內部矩形（SCI）。<lb/>一個超參數 $γ$ $\in$ (0, 1) 獨立於 $α$ 控制基矩形的分位數水平。<lb/>我們證明了向下封閉性和矩形夾心界限，並推導出一個封閉形式的外部矩形。<lb/>在29個真實世界數據集上的實驗確認了有效的聯合覆蓋；SC 2 以 $γ$ = 1-$α$ 始終相對於基準達到競爭性的體積，並且隨著輸出維度 d 的增加而增長優勢。
